PlussMa

Numerical and mathematical foundations for Pluss: optimization routines, probability distributions, statistical finance, and regression, organized as one topic folder per domain.

API Reference

What's in this space

Each domain below owns its own nested docs/ folder next to its source code, aggregated into this hub automatically.

Optimization Math/Numerical/optimization

Optimizers, sequential QP, and the internal solver protocol.

Distributions Stats/distributions

Probability distribution objects and their reference API.

Finance & Regression Stats/finance, Stats/regression

Statistical finance and regression tooling, as those topic folders grow their own docs/.
